A new builder carrying the index flag.

## Remarks

Two forms: `.index(name?)` for a single-column index (replaces any composite marker), and `.index([`<!-- -->a`, `<!-- -->b`, ...])` for a concatenated-key composite over the listed columns (replaces any single marker, clears `unique`<!-- -->). The composite is named `a+b`<!-- -->, lives in `{db}:idx:{a+b}`<!-- -->, and is queried with full tuples (point), short tuples (prefix), or `{start, end}` bounds (range). By convention declare it on the first column; arity must be ≥ 2 (enforced at registration).
